app.name: BulbMatch
app.summary: An offline-first mobile utility that turns confirmed lamp markings into a conservative replacement shopping profile for 220–240 V / 50 Hz regions.

electricalScope.marketPosition: Regional guidance only; not a fixture-safety certification.

requirements.title: Start immediately with Match, History, and Reference navigation
Capture a bulb-marking photo with the device camera
Import one image through the system photo picker
Enter all matching data manually without a photo
Require an explicit decision for every OCR-derived field
Gate assessment on a confirmed known base and voltage
Treat an unknown base as Need clarification
Return deterministic compatible, clarification, or conflict outcomes
Block a positive outcome for voltage conflicts or out-of-scope voltage
Keep fixture maximum wattage separate and never infer it
Explain the result before showing a shopping checklist
Save a result explicitly with an optional name
Review, delete, and clear locally saved history
Browse an offline reference for common lamp bases
Bundle the catalog and OCR models for first-run offline use
Support system-selected and manually selected English or Russian
Support accessible, responsive light and dark UI
Process photos ephemerally and keep unfinished work in memory only
Report crashes without OCR, photo, or custom user data
Place Yandex ads only in four approved placements per platform
Apply a conservative interstitial eligibility and frequency cap
Collapse failed ads and enforce test and release ad configuration
Version and audit every catalog and rule source
Recover from permissions, unavailable camera, blur, and OCR failure
Make false-positive prevention the release guardrail
Expose language, theme, privacy, source, and local-data controls

constraints.offlineMode: Core capture, bundled on-device OCR, manual entry, assessment, catalog browsing, save, and history work without connectivity. Advertising and crash delivery may wait or fail without affecting the core flow.
privacy: Do not persist photos, thumbnails, full OCR transcripts, or unfinished scans.
Do not send photos, OCR text, confirmed lamp values, saved-result names, or stable user identifiers to Firebase Crashlytics.

Use non-personalized Yandex ad configuration globally: do not request ATT, remove Android advertising-ID permission, disable location signals, do not pass targeting parameters, and set user-consent state before SDK initialization.
The product is not directed to children and must not claim child-directed treatment.
accessibility: Meet WCAG 2.2 AA intent for contrast, semantics, focus order, touch targets, non-color status cues, and text scaling.
At 200% font scale, safety content and primary actions remain reachable without clipping or horizontal scrolling.
All diagrams have meaningful text alternatives and all advertisement containers expose an Advertisement label.
performance: Show Match home without waiting for network SDKs.
On a supported mid-range device and a legible image, provide OCR candidates within 2.5 seconds at p95 after image confirmation.
Run a confirmed compatibility assessment within 100 ms at p95.
Never delay safety content, saving, or navigation while an advertisement loads.
releaseBoundary: Android is delivered first; iOS remains a first-class build and acceptance target.
No account, product analytics, catalog download, backend, export, cloud backup, or cross-device data transfer in MVP.
No result may claim that a fixture, wiring, enclosure, dimmer, or installation is safe.

monetization.strategy: Advertising is subordinate to task completion and safety comprehension.

finalReviewer.name: Sergey V.
finalReviewer.role: Product owner and final catalog/ruleset reviewer

reviewMethod: Automated checks and multiple AI models may generate cases, challenge rules, and flag inconsistencies.
AI output is advisory; Sergey V. makes and records the final approval decision for each production catalog, ruleset, and safety fixture suite version.

successCriteria.primary: Zero known false-positive compatible recommendations in the approved safety fixture suite and field-review sample.
successCriteria.guardrail: When required facts are unknown, contradictory, unsupported, or outside 220–240 V / 50 Hz, the app must withhold a positive recommendation.
secondary: Users can reopen a useful saved result without rescanning.
Ad revenue is observable in the Yandex console without product analytics.
